policy: Suggestions are bounded experiments only; they never authorize source mutation or promotion.

prologue_epilogue_or_callee_save: split or merge a pure initializer without moving its evaluation
test an already evidenced translation-unit flag profile
register_allocation_only: change pointer retention into an explicit reload
split a nested pure expression into one temporary
branch_shape_or_polarity: invert the condition and exchange behaviorally identical arms
literal_pool_or_base_folding: test the strongest multi-function translation-unit hypothesis
verify every candidate literal word before scoring exactness
argument_spill_or_abi_typing: review argument widths and small by-value aggregates across all callers
split or merge a pure initializer
recompile every affected caller after an explicit prototype review
instruction_selection_or_promotion: move a narrowing cast while preserving the reviewed mathematical domain
relocation_or_call_state: resolve the call edge state from analyzed target evidence
verify address-named relocation and independent literal value
stop if any relocation remains unsupported
source_unit_flag_policy: test only already evidenced interworking or nointerworking profiles
require improvement across multiple unit members
suspected_wrong_behavior: return to CFG, call order, memory writes, and return provenance
generate a distinguishing behavioral input before further exact search
